content: The test image shows a very young soybean seedling at soil level with what appears to be rotted/decayed cotyledons — one appears dark brown/necrotic and shriveled, with wet soil conditions. This points to an early seedling disease. Top candidates: Pythium_damping_off, Rhizoctonia, Phytophthora.

The test image is a near-perfect match to the Pythium_damping_off reference collage:
- Very young seedling at soil surface with one cotyledon appearing soft-rotted/dark and necrotic
- Wet, muddy soil conditions
- The rotted seed/cotyledon on the right side shows the characteristic soft decay

Rhizoctonia shows reddish-brown dry firm lesions on hypocotyls — not matching. Phytophthora shows more advanced wilting with dark stem lesions extending upward — not matching.
